note: See grant_contract.mjs. Entries may only be REMOVED, never edited to hide a regression. Migration 031 closed 43 of the 47 findings from this file's first run: rules A, B and H are now clean. The four that remain are one decision, not four bugs.

entries.why: NOLOGIN with no members, so nothing can ever assume this role. The grants and policies it holds are correct and now complete (migration 031); what is missing is a way for any process to BE it. Closing this means choosing between three security models with materially different behaviour under compromise — see HP-JOB-007 §5. Note that the cheapest option, GRANT <role> TO hp_app, is a trap in this cluster: hp_app has rolinherit = true and would silently acquire every privilege at all times rather than having to assume the role explicitly.
entries.item: R13-conn — the connection-model decision. HP-JOB-007 §5. Yours, not engineering's.
